hero.headline: I build fast, clean websites.
hero.subtitle: I work with Astro, React, TypeScript and Tailwind. In my free time I also make small games.
hero.imageAlt: A desk at sunset with a laptop, a game controller and a sleeping cat

about.title: A bit about me
about.paragraph1: I'm a developer based in Poland, I build fast, clean websites and web apps, mostly with Astro and React. I develop demo games because I enjoy turning ideas and problems into creative experiences that are both useful and fun.
about.paragraph2: When I'm not coding, you'll probably find me playing games, exploring new ideas or working on the next side project.
about.imageAlt: A laptop showing code, a tablet and a phone on a desk
about.skillsText: I work with modern technologies to build websites, games and custom tools. I'm always learning and exploring new ways to create better digital experiences.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.text: I'm looking for a web developer role and open to freelance projects. Email is the quickest way to reach me.

tic-tac-toe.description: Classic two-player game - tracks turns, detects wins and draws, resets in one click.

hero.flavor: Websites and small tools, built with care. A developer's oath: code forged clean, pages quick as a royal courier, and knightly vigils long after the sun sets.

domain.title: The Domain
domain.baroniesSubtitle: Six smaller holdings, kept close to the keep.

kosmetologia.description: A beauty parlour that lets its photography do the talking; full-bleed imagery, quiet typography.

kawiarnia.description: Built to give a local coffee shop everything it actually needs online: a warm first impression, a clear menu, and an easy way to get in touch.

haymakers.description: A fighter game demo - step into the arena, pick your warrior and settle the dispute with steel in a playable browser light prototype.

epochronos.description: Match each epoch to its place, before chronos catches up - drag the ages into order across categories, eras, and timed challenges.

council.title: The Small Council
council.chancellorDesc: Client relations, scoping, and the occasional difficult conversation about deadlines.
council.stewardDesc: Budgets, timelines, and keeping a project's scope from quietly doubling.
council.spymasterDesc: Debugging, QA, and finding the one edge case everyone else missed.
council.physicianDesc: Maintenance, patches, and keeping a site healthy long after launch.
council.bio:
One person holds every office above - no court, no retinue, just a developer who handles both sides of the work: client websites that need speed and clarity, and personal builds of games or mechanics designed from scratch.
 Currently sworn to React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, with Astro for lighter holdings.
